summary: Steakholder Foods filed a 6-K disclosing inducement offer letters under which holders of existing warrants will exercise ~892,854 ADSs at a reduced price of $1.25/ADS, generating ~$1.1M gross proceeds. In exchange, the company will issue Series C and Series D warrants to purchase up to ~1.79M ADSs. H.C. Wainwright serves as placement agent, receiving 7.5% cash fee plus warrants. The transaction is a warrant repricing and capital raise, not a special situation; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. Filing is a routine financing update.
